vera/studio-archive.title: Find a client’s documents with Vera
vera/studio-archive.goal: Learn to connect a studio folder, search the right client and obtain an answer linked to its source documents.
vera/studio-archive.scenario: The studio wants to find Ciclo Arco’s agreed maintenance service and the end date stated in its agreement. The fictional archive also contains another client.
vera/studio-archive.scope: Local document search. Gmail, WhatsApp and Google Drive are separate routes requiring their own connections; this lesson does not activate them.
vera/studio-archive.inputs: Open archive: it contains Ciclo Arco and Delta, each with its own agreement. Vera prepares a teaching copy and separate local index while retaining your existing studio archive settings.
vera/studio-archive.request: Vera, find Ciclo Arco’s agreement with Tecnica Esempio. What service is provided and until when? Show the passages supporting your answer.
steps: In the working chat, Vera prepares the teaching folder, checks access and indexes readable documents. If a folder selection is needed, choose the exercise folder.
Select Ciclo Arco. The current workflow searches within that client and opens relevant sources; the voice chat explains the move from a search result to its document.
Read the answer and open its citations. Check the client, monthly service and stated period. Locate any extraction limits or documents that were not indexed.
deliverables: Answer with source links: service, period and the document passages describing them.
Index status and search trail: selected client, opened sources and encountered limits.
vera/studio-archive.review: Check the selected client and read the cited passage. Search finds content in indexed files; it does not prove that all agreements are present or that a document is legally valid.
checkpoints: Before searching, identify Ciclo Arco’s folder.
At delivery, open a citation and find the stated fact in its document.
vera/studio-archive.practice: Add update-en.md from the practice files to the Ciclo Arco teaching copy, keep the agreement and ask Vera to refresh the index. Repeat the end-date question and open both sources.
vera/studio-archive.success: The answer reflects the extension to 30 June 2027 and retains the original agreement reference. Explain when the index needs refreshing.
vera/studio-archive.repeat: Name the client and a concrete question. Refresh after new documents arrive and open the sources before relying on the answer.

vera/archive-organization.title: Organise a client folder with Vera
vera/archive-organization.goal: Learn to obtain an organisation plan, review destinations and apply approved changes to a folder.
vera/archive-organization.scenario: Ciclo Arco’s folder contains an agreement, an exact copy and an internal meeting note in two intake folders. We will prepare a readable plan and try it on a teaching copy.
vera/archive-organization.scope: One client and fictional local files. Applying changes requires an explicit choice; the lesson does not change the real studio archive.
vera/archive-organization.inputs: Open client and inspect Da archiviare and Download. Read the agreement and meeting note. Vera copies them into a separate teaching client and uses the workflow’s studio folder policy. Default folder labels are Italian.
vera/archive-organization.request: Vera, propose how to organise this Ciclo Arco folder. Show documents, destinations and duplicate copies before moving anything.
steps: The working chat creates the teaching client and captures its file snapshot. Vera reads the necessary evidence and proposes categories and destinations from the contents.
Open the generated review page. Inspect every proposal, keep or edit the destination and decide how to handle the exact copy. The plan remains proposed until reviewed.

After those decisions, Vera summarises planned moves and separately asks whether to apply them. If you approve the teaching-copy changes, it executes the plan and shows the resulting folders and operation journal.
deliverables: Review page and plan: starting files, proposed destinations, reasons and saved decisions.
After authorized application: organised folder and journal for checking moves and considering rollback.
vera/archive-organization.review: Follow a document from its original location to its destination. The exact copy is retained in the duplicate-review area rather than deleted. Reviewing a proposal is separate from authorizing file moves.
checkpoints: Before the plan, identify the client and teaching folder.
Before application, explain one chosen destination and check the planned moves.
vera/archive-organization.practice: Use the new client copy in the practice files, which adds update-en.md. Request another plan, review where the update belongs with its agreement and decide whether to apply it. Preserve the demonstration.
vera/archive-organization.success: You can read the plan, change a proposal and distinguish review from application. If you do not authorize moves, the result remains a plan to review, not an already organised folder.
vera/archive-organization.repeat: Select a client, request a proposal and review every change. Apply after the explicit summary and retain the journal.
